title: Stay Close to the Light

items.name: Robot lighthouse keeper
items.description: The tall robot has rusty shoulders and kind, tired eyes.

details.prompt: A tall, broad robot with faded blue iron plates, salt-white streaks and orange rust around the rivets, long arms, rounded fingers, heavy feet and two kind amber eyes under a low brow.
details.voice: He speaks slowly in a deep, tired voice, with a gentle pause between sentences.

items.name: Little red fox
items.description: The little red fox has black paws and a fluffy tail with a white tip.

details.prompt: A small red fox with russet fur, black paws, a white chin, pointed ears, bright brown eyes and a thick white-tipped tail.
details.voice: Quick, bright and cheeky, like a friend trying to hide a smile.

items.message: The Little red fox could not be given a skeleton: bone_names failed (exit 1): rigged.glb: no humanoid body found in the skeleton (legs too short to find the feet: [['bone_22', 'bone_23', 'bone_24', 'bone_25'], ['bone_21']])

items.name: Wooden pier
items.description: Wet boards shine in the dark above thick wooden posts.

details.prompt: A wooden pier eight metres long and four metres wide, with a flat deck of wet planks on stout round posts. Deep blue-grey wood at the edges fades to pale fog-grey at the far end.

items.name: Glowing lantern
items.description: Warm yellow light shines through the glass of a little metal lantern.

details.prompt: An old iron lantern with a curved carry handle, clear glass panes and a bright golden flame behind the glass, with a warm glow along the metal frame.

items.message: Taken from the Otto Forge library.

items.name: Wooden crate
items.description: This low wooden box has a wide, flat lid for the fox.

details.prompt: A closed wooden shipping crate, one metre long, with a broad flat plank lid, worn corners and dark nail heads.

items.message: Taken from the Otto Forge library.

items.name: Brass telescope
items.description: A long brass telescope rests on three wooden legs.

details.prompt: An old brass telescope mounted on a sturdy three-legged wooden tripod, with a round glass lens, a narrow eyepiece and a brass hinge joining the tube to the stand.

items.name: Coil of rope
items.description: A thick rope lies in a big coil on the boards.

details.prompt: One big flat coil of thick tan dock rope, with rough twisted strands, damp patches and a short loose end.

items.message: Taken from the Otto Forge library.

attach_to.where: on the deck beside the keeper

notes: The fox stands still on the crate facing the taller keeper because Otto cannot make it sit or tip its head up.
The pier has dark blue boards and a pale grey far end to suggest a foggy night because Otto has no fog or night setting in this plan.
The keeper's warning, the fox's reply and its yip are listed in speaking order because the plan has no way to time them.
The Robot lighthouse keeper does not hold the Glowing lantern yet; they stand next to it for now.
I put the Robot lighthouse keeper on top of the Wooden pier because I can't find its middle of the deck yet.
I put the Glowing lantern on top of the Robot lighthouse keeper because I can't find its right_hand yet.
I put the Wooden crate on top of the Wooden pier because I can't find its on the deck beside the keeper yet.
I put the Brass telescope on top of the Wooden pier because I can't find its back right of the deck yet.
I put the Coil of rope on top of the Wooden pier because I can't find its front right of the deck yet.
